name: mibba
description: Research notarial dossiers and documents in Mibba with authenticated, workspace-scoped tools.

interface.shortDescription: Research notarial dossiers with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your authorized Mibba workspace to find dossiers, inspect documents, search page-level evidence, audit cited pieces and deadlines, and produce complete activity reports. Mibba scopes every tool call to the workspace authorized during OAuth sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Find a dossier in Mibba and summarize its available documents.
Audit the cited pieces and deadlines in this Mibba dossier.
Report this year's monthly dossier activity from Mibba.
